Date: Jan 26, 2023
Time: 12:09 PM

This recording captures the peaceful sounds of Al-Azhar Park in Cairo. You can hear the sound of running water from the park’s small artificial river and the call to prayer (Adhan) from nearby mosques. The recording is a great way to experience the tranquility of this beautiful park in the heart of old Cairo.
title: ​Adhan in Al-Azhar Park - Cairo
author: AhmadAiuby
